verdict.rationale: Wise Business is a licensed, Wise-operated payments and multi-currency account service. Its core value is regulated money movement over Wise's own licenses and banking rails, so self-hosting it is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence describes only hosted APIs, a Wise-hosted sandbox and Wise-hosted embedded flows, and nothing suggests a deployable self-hosted edition.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
